criteria.requirement: Add DateTimeParser.parse_match(text, format_or_list, normalize_whitespace=False) returning immutable ParsedDateTimeMatch with value datetime, selected format, original span/matched/prefix/suffix and a separate normalized_span. Select the earliest calendar-valid match across formats, breaking equal-position ties by format order; skip invalid dates and empty/literal-only matches. Preserve raw Unicode and whitespace exactly. If whitespace is normalized for matching, map every matched normalized character back to its original span rather than pretending normalized indices refer to raw input. Use the complete strict token parser and preserve old parse return types and boundaries.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
